options.name: access_policy
options.description: Name of a custom management access policy to bind the directory service role to, instead of a built-in I(role). Mutually exclusive with I(role). Either I(role) or I(access_policy) is required when I(state=present). Requires Purity//FA 6.6.9, or higher (REST 2.36).

options.name: api_token
options.description: FlashArray API token for admin privileged user.

options.name: client_id
options.description: ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: context
options.description: Name of fleet member on which to perform the operation. This requires the array receiving the request is a member of a fleet and the context name to be a member of the same fleet.

options.name: disable_warnings
options.description: Disable insecure certificate warnings in debug logs

options.name: fa_url
options.description: FlashArray management IPv4 address or Hostname.

options.name: group
options.description: Sets the common Name (CN) of the configured directory service group containing users for the FlashBlade. This name should be just the Common Name of the group without the CN= specifier. Common Names should not exceed 64 characters in length.

options.name: group_base
options.description: Specifies where the configured group is located in the directory tree. This field consists of Organizational Units (OUs) that combine with the base DN attribute and the configured group CNs to complete the full Distinguished Name of the groups. The group base should specify OU= for each OU and multiple OUs should be separated by commas. The order of OUs is important and should get larger in scope from left to right. Each OU should not exceed 64 characters in length.

options.name: id_token
options.description: A pre-signed JWT to authenticate with, as an alternative to I(api_token). The token is exchanged by the array for a short-lived access token. Requires a matching API Client to be registered on the array (see M(everpure.flasharray.purefa_apiclient)).

options.name: issuer
options.description: The API Client's trusted identity issuer registered on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: key_id
options.description: Key ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of role If not providied, will be assigned to the same as I(role)

options.name: private_key_file
options.description: Path to the PEM RSA private key used to sign an identity token, as an alternative to I(api_token). Requires I(client_id), I(key_id), I(issuer) and I(username).

options.name: role
options.description: The built-in directory service role to work on. Mutually exclusive with I(access_policy). Either I(role) or I(access_policy) is required when I(state=present).

options.name: state
options.description: Create or delete directory service role

options.name: username
options.description: Username the issued token should be granted to. Must be a valid user on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).
